method: Direct view_image inspection of all twelve actual baseline/candidate stage and collar PNGs; no image transformation or browser launch.

adult-pose5: The candidate removes the irregular skin-colored projection below and to the right of the neck that was visible in the baseline.
The blue collar now follows a smooth rounded boundary around the neck, with continuous highlight and shadow. The upper shoulder transition is also smoother.
The full stage confirms the improvement at ordinary viewing scale. The face, ear, supporting hand, wrist and camera framing remain visually aligned.
adult-pose8: The candidate removes the jagged lower neck-side patch and the segmented blue/skin intersections visible in the baseline.
The collar edge reads as a continuous garment boundary with smoother shading.
The head and supporting hand remain aligned in the same frame; no new visible gaps or detached edges appear at the neck join.
infant-pose8-contrast: The 320-pixel contrast view preserves the clear white head and supporting hand against the dark gray shirt and black background.
The complete supporting hand remains visible with its dark outlines. The head/hand relationship and stage framing match the baseline.
The neckline is mostly occluded by the infant head from this camera. The visible edge remains clean, with no new protrusion or gap apparent in either the stage or collar crop.

assessment: Accept the final source for all three inspected matched views. The adult neck-side artifact is removed and the collar is smoother. The narrow infant contrast view remains legible.
